questions.question: What event is considered the moment when Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment?
choices: A: He sat under a Bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya.
B: He spoke with a Brahmin about life.

What do the five rings of the Olympic Games symbolize?

The five rings of the Olympic Games represent the five continents: Africa, America, Asia, Europe, and Oceania. This symbolism underscores the international nature of the Games and the gathering of athletes from around the world.

D: The five countries of the first Olympics
